summary.en: Pierre Fabre’s investigational pipeline is concentrated in early precision oncology, complemented by fetal protein replacement. Acquisitions and purchased development rights supply several of its clinical assets.
summary.zh: Pierre Fabre 的在研管线集中于早期精准肿瘤,并辅以胎儿蛋白替代疗法。收购和购买的开发权益提供了其若干临床资产。

counts.note: As reported on the undated Pierre Fabre Pharmaceuticals US pipeline page, accessed November 17, 2026; Phase III count not separately disclosed.

target.zh: 外胚层发育不良蛋白 A1 (Ectodysplasin A1) 替代

ind.zh: X 连锁少汗性外胚层发育不良
MET 改变的非小细胞肺癌
EGFR 20 号外显子插入突变 NSCLC
EGFR 19/21 号外显子加 C797S 突变 NSCLC

watch.en: Tabelecleucel’s resubmitted US BLA has a March 31, 2027 action date; its regulatory history merits attention.
watch.zh: Tabelecleucel 重新提交的美国 BLA 行动日期为 2027 年 3 月 31 日;其监管历程值得关注。

watch.en: In 2025, 89% of pharmaceutical R&D investment went to precision oncology.
watch.zh: 2025 年,药品研发投入的 89% 用于精准肿瘤。

watch.en: The company purchased worldwide PFL-721 and PFL-241 rights from Antares in 2025.
watch.zh: 2025 年,公司从 Antares 购得 PFL-721 和 PFL-241 的全球权益。

watch.en: Pharmaceuticals generated 44% of 2025 revenue; dermo-cosmetics and personal care generated 55%.
watch.zh: 药品占 2025 年收入的 44%;皮肤美容和个人护理占 55%。

gaps: The US pipeline page explicitly reports four Phase I products, one Phase II product and one registration product. No separate Phase III total is stated; counts.p3 is null. These are company-reported US portfolio counts, not counts of the selected items.

Tabelecleucel is excluded from items because it is already approved outside the US and the reviewed US filing concerns the same indication, rather than a major new indication. Its ongoing US review is retained in watch.

The April corporate R&D page says four clinical agents, while the March results release says five clinical molecules and the US page describes six products including registration; scope and dates differ and were not reconciled into new totals.

The US pipeline is undated. The latest group results located were published March 19, 2026, before 2026-06. The April R&D snapshot, June 2025 asset-rights release and September 2023 acquisition release also predate 2026-06; old transaction sources establish origin only.
ER004 origin and additional asset codes were not verified and are null. Dated upcoming milestones for the five selected assets were not verified; next is null.

PFL-002 is described in a Phase I/II study announcement but as Phase I on the pipeline; phase 1 follows the pipeline. Purchased worldwide rights for PFL-721/PFL-241 are classified as acquired, rather than inferred internal discovery.
